protocol.selection: Use both existing checkpoints unchanged. Do not train, tune thresholds or pick favorable crops. Preserve all failures and compare full exported results against source photographs.
protocol.limits: Six inspected development observations. Source groups are disjoint from the original pilot, but motif families overlap and this is not a pristine test set. No original cutting geometry is available.

labelsAudit.scope: All source hashes, inherited groups, transforms, known/unknown labels and RGB pixels; not an independent human annotation audit.

metrics.scope: Known pixels only; excludes uncertain outline bands, occlusions and letterbox padding. No boundary-localization or complete-crop accuracy claim.

modelVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of saved source, scene probability, and both model error overlays; not independent human annotation review.
modelVisualReview.observation: Scene-trained field follows the blue/yellow body closely; a few edge and tip pixels are missed. Control includes broad surrounding background patches.

modelVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of saved source, scene probability, and both model error overlays; not independent human annotation review.
modelVisualReview.observation: Scene-trained field excludes most pinecone and greenery but retains much of the red handle and has a small false hole in the left lobe. Control includes broad decorations and background.

modelVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of saved source, scene probability, and both model error overlays; not independent human annotation review.
modelVisualReview.observation: Scene-trained field largely follows the boar heart while shaving some lobe edges and the tip. Control claims much of the upper background.

modelVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of saved source, scene probability, and both model error overlays; not independent human annotation review.
modelVisualReview.observation: Scene-trained field includes some carpet/shadow above both lobes and loses a pale strip along the lower-left body and tip. Control claims most carpet around the heart.

modelVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of saved source, scene probability, and both model error overlays; not independent human annotation review.
modelVisualReview.observation: Scene-trained field includes the bright reflection/wood above and right of the gold lobe and loses parts of the pale lower-left edge/tip. Control includes most of the wood.

modelVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of saved source, scene probability, and both model error overlays; not independent human annotation review.
modelVisualReview.observation: Scene-trained field includes parts of both hands and loses some pale lobe pixels. Contact regions marked unknown are not scored. Control includes much larger hand and background areas.

pipelineVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of actual saved photographs, proposed crops, classified masks and independently rendered exports. No original cutting-path ground truth.
pipelineVisualReview.observation: The crop includes a narrow strip of background near the lower/right edge. The four-by-four checker is retained, but the fitted result has border fringes and unwanted curved protrusions.

pipelineVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of actual saved photographs, proposed crops, classified masks and independently rendered exports. No original cutting-path ground truth.
pipelineVisualReview.observation: The proposed overlap follows the checker more closely and excludes most outside background. All sixteen cells remain; edge spacing is uneven and fitted corners remain rounded. Lower error is against a changed crop-derived mask, not an identical target.

pipelineVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of actual saved photographs, proposed crops, classified masks and independently rendered exports. No original cutting-path ground truth.
pipelineVisualReview.observation: The automatic quadrilateral cuts through the angel rather than following its physical overlap. Classification also loses part of the bright gold paper at the top. The reconstructed motif is badly distorted and fails the image gate.

pipelineVisualReview.review: Assistant inspection of actual saved photographs, proposed crops, classified masks and independently rendered exports. No original cutting-path ground truth.
pipelineVisualReview.observation: The crop follows the visible checker body despite retained handle pixels in the neural field. The four-by-four checker is recognizable, with slightly rounded corners and small border irregularities.

editableVisualReview.observation: Editable rendering inspected; checker structure and previously noted contour/border imperfections are retained.

harnessNotes.scope: Harness failed before browser launch; no website or gallery failure was observed.
harnessNotes.correction: Use the existing owned Playwright shim also used by the completed release browser run. No install or shared browser tooling.

unitTests.scope: Includes probe pixel/transform fidelity, unknown-pixel loss, QA exclusions and semantic annotation verification; command completed before frozen inference.

limitations: Six inspected development photographs, with overlapping motif families; not an unseen test or the fixed 31-photo reconstruction benchmark.
Known-region IoU excludes uncertain outlines and occlusions.
Template error is against each method's different crop-derived mask, not unavailable artwork/cut ground truth.
No new model training, ONNX/browser inference, website change, or physical assembly test.
